Key points
• Adolescence marks a stage of physical, mental and intellectual development, with nutrient recommendations being higher
than at any other stage throughout the life cycle.
• Increased nutritional requirements in adolescence, combined with a tendency toward less healthy eating patterns, make this
group susceptible to vitamin and mineral inadequacies.
• Adolescence is an opportune time to instill healthy eating patterns that can persist into adulthood.
• Obesity in adolescence is not just restricted to high-income countries and has short and long-term implications for the
individual.
